messages:
maria: Heads-up — planned blue->green shift for svc-router. Window starts 2024-06-08 17:00 UTC, target duration ~30m. Rolling weights: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Pin session-stickiness for 15m during shift. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/svc-router/v4.3.0 :notes: 
chris: ack. who’s owning rollback? @samir? :eyes:
samir: I’ll be on-call for rollback and post-checks. Will monitor p95, 5xx rate, and error budget alarms.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout for svc-router v4.3.0 at 1746823800 (queued). CI checks passed.
maria: quick checklist: 1) pin version in route-weights 2) disable autoscale burst for 10m 3) enable kv-prefix cache warmup 4) devex notified.
kai: added note to release doc: remind customers of session-affinity change.
chris: small nit — do we have a probing job for synthetic traffic to validate KV cache hit-rate?
maria: yes, synthetic probe running from canary agents in us-west1 and eu-west1 every 30s. Probe thresholds: p95 <= 160ms, 5xx < 0.1% or rollback.
deploy-bot: starting step 1 -> shift to 5% traffic to v4.3.0 now. rollout_id=rr-20240608-1746
maria: watching metrics (console link) — will call if p95 jumps or errors go up.
samir: seeing p95 tick up in us-west1 to ~190ms, 5xx at 0.15% (temporary spike). Holding at 5% for 3 mins to observe.
chris: hold the ramp. don’t advance to 25% yet.
maria: agreed — hold. sending a quick comparison trace dump to #eng-sre.
samir: after 6m, p95 still elevated and a small uptick in connection resets from edge. decision: pause and roll back to v4.2.1 to be safe.
chris: initiating rollback. deploy-bot, please revert weights to previous config and mark incident if required.
deploy-bot: rollback action started. reverting weights -> v4.2.1 100% (applied). rollback complete. rollout_id=rr-20240608-1746, status=rolled_back
maria: confirmed traffic back on v4.2.1. p95 returning to baseline. Good call.
kai: updated release notes: "hotfix required — investigate session-affinity change causing transient cache misses". Will schedule a follow-up patch.
samir: filing a short postmortem draft and adding probe traces + config diffs. tagging @chris for routing rule review.
chris: thanks. let’s add a pre-rollout probe step next time: ramp to 1% and run a 10min soak with KV hit-rate check.
maria: agreed. action items: 1) revert session-affinity experiment in staging; 2) add 1% soak gate to rollout playbook; 3) patch v4.3.0 and try again next week during low-traffic window.
samir: will follow up in the postmortem doc and assign owners.
maria: closing thread — thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
